title: [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois..., pages 650 bis à 787, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting. M_{0,3} is P^1 minus {0,1,∞} over Q. S_3 acts on it by Q-automorphisms that permute the three punctures, and the stack quotient (M_{0,3,Q}, S_3) is identified with (a rigidified) M_{1,1,Q}. Let Π be the geometric profinite π_1, which is free profinite on two generators. Then M^ = Π^ab = Π/[Π,Π] ≅ M ⊗ Ẑ. Here M = H_1(P^1−3 points, Z) = Z^3/Z(1,1,1), with S_3 permuting the three puncture loops and Γ_Q acting through the cyclotomic character. Dividing the arithmetic fundamental group of the stack by [Π,Π] gives an extension E: 1 → M^ → E → Γ = Γ_Q × S_3 → 1. Γ is a direct product because the S_3-action is defined over Q.

What has been done so far.
- In n°11 a quotient G~_{q,σ} of this situation was built; it satisfies properties a), b), c).
- The Fermat tower (curves x^n + y^n = 1, Galois with group μ_n^2 over P^1−{0,1,∞}, stable under S_3, defined over Q) gives another such object.
- Each object amounts to a splitting of E, equivalently a Q-rational, S_3-equivariant pro-cover of M_{1,1,Q}. After forgetting S_3 and extending scalars to Q̄, this pro-cover becomes the universal abelian cover of M_{0,3,Q̄}.
- Grothendieck remarks that without the Fermat tower he would not have suspected that the 'non-extension' (the extension of H~^+ ≅ S_3 by M^) is semi-direct.

The conjecture on this page. The two pro-covers (the one from n°11 and the Fermat one) are isomorphic, and the isomorphism is unique.

The cohomological check.
- Splitting classes are classified by H^1(Γ, M^). Grothendieck writes the five-term sequence (294) of the Hochschild–Serre spectral sequence for S_3 ⊂ Γ with quotient Γ_Q: 0 → H^1(Γ_Q, H^0(S_3,M^)) → H^1(Γ,M^) → H^0(Γ_Q, H^1(S_3,M^)) → H^2(Γ_Q, H^0(S_3,M^)).
- By (295), H^0(S_3,M^) = 0, so H^1(Γ,M^) ≅ H^0(Γ_Q, H^1(S_3,M^)).
- Since Ẑ is flat, H^1(S_3,M^) = H^1(S_3,M) ⊗ Ẑ.
- The next page gets H^1(S_3,M) = 0 from the earlier result that splittings of the S_3-extension exist and are conjugate by a unique element. Hence H^1(Γ_Q × S_3, M^) = 0 (297).

Consequence (theorem, next page). There is an essentially unique profinite cover U_∞ of (U_{0,3,Q}, S_3) = M_{1,1,Q} whose pullback to Q̄ is the universal abelian cover. Uniqueness up to unique isomorphism follows from H^0 = H^1 = 0, which proves the conjecture.

Independent check. Write M = Z^3/diag.
- S_3-invariants: (a,b,c) invariant mod diag under transpositions forces a = b = c, so H^0 = 0.
- From 0 → Z → Z^3 → M → 0 and Shapiro's lemma, H^1(S_3,Z^3) = H^1(S_2,Z) = 0.
- The map H^2(S_3,Z) = Hom(S_3,Q/Z) = Z/2 → H^2(S_3,Z^3) = Hom(S_2,Q/Z) = Z/2 is restriction of the sign character, an isomorphism.
- Hence H^1(S_3,M) = 0. Both claims are correct.
errors: In the last term of (294) Grothendieck writes H^2(Γ_Q, H^0(S_3, M)) without the hat; it should be M^. This is harmless since the term vanishes anyway.

The parenthetical 'H^0(L_j, M^) = 0' is true for the cyclic subgroup of order 3: shift-invariance mod diag forces 3k = 0. For a subgroup of order 2 it is false: H^0(S_2, Z^3/diag) ≅ Z, generated by the class of (0,0,1). So L_j must denote the order-3 stabilizer (j = 0) or some other group; the reading is uncertain.
Minor: E is described as an extension of H~^+ ≅ S_3 'by M^' while discrete M and profinite M^ are used somewhat interchangeably. This does not affect the vanishing results.

ideas.what: View the abelianized arithmetic fundamental group of the stack (P^1−{0,1,∞}, S_3) ≈ M_{1,1} over Q as an extension of Γ_Q × S_3 by M^ = Π^ab. Classify Q-rational, S_3-equivariant models of the universal abelian cover as splittings, governed by H^1(Γ_Q × S_3, M^).
ideas.modern_name: Sections/splittings of the metabelian (abelianized) fundamental group exact sequence; descent of the maximal abelian cover
ideas.usually_credited_to: Ihara (Fermat-tower description of Π/Π'', 1985–86); Anderson ('The hyperadelic gamma function', 1989); Deligne
ideas.where_published: Not in Esquisse d'un programme in this form; La Longue Marche (1981) is only partly circulated.

ideas.what: The Fermat tower realizes a Q-rational, S_3-equivariant splitting: the extension of S_3 by M^ is semi-direct, which Grothendieck says he would not have suspected.
ideas.modern_name: Fermat curves as the universal abelian cover of P^1−{0,1,∞} over Q (Fermat Jacobians and Π^ab)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Ihara, Anderson; Coleman; Rohrlich (Fermat curve periods/Galois action)
ideas.where_published: Possibly mentioned in La Longue Marche; unsure.

ideas.what: Computation H^0(S_3,M) = H^1(S_3,M) = 0 for M = Z^3/diag. Via Hochschild–Serre this gives H^1(Γ_Q × S_3, M^) = 0, hence uniqueness up to unique isomorphism of the descended abelian cover of M_{1,1,Q}.
ideas.modern_name: Hochschild–Serre five-term exact sequence; rigidity of descent data

missed.claim: Rigidity statement: the universal abelian pro-cover of P^1−{0,1,∞}_{Q̄} has a model over the stack M_{1,1,Q} = (M_{0,3}, S_3) that is unique up to unique isomorphism, because H^0 = H^1(Γ_Q × S_3, M^) = 0. That model must therefore be the Fermat tower. The S_3-equivariant, unique-up-to-unique-isomorphism formulation over M_{1,1} is not usually stated this way in the Ihara/Anderson literature, though the ingredients are elementary.
missed.quote: La conjecture que je pressens tout de suite, c'est que ces deux prorevêtements précédents sont isomorphes - l'isomorphisme entre les deux étant donc unique.
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: It gives a canonical, Galois-and-S_3-equivariant base point at the metabelian level for anabelian and Grothendieck–Teichmüller computations. It is a modest but clean descent statement that predates Ihara's Fermat-tower work by a few years.

deep.surprise_reason: The mathematics is correct and elementary. The use of the Fermat tower to split the metabelian quotient over Q, with an S_3-equivariant uniqueness argument, anticipates Ihara/Anderson-type ideas around 1981. The core facts are known to specialists, however, so it is a notable but not startling unpublished detail.

'je n'aurais entre pas suspecté' should be 'je n'aurais certes pas suspecté'.
'La conjecture que je prévois' is more likely 'La conjecture que je pressens'.

'ces deux précisément précédées sont isomorphes - l'isomorphisme entre les deux [-sont-] dans unique' should read 'ces deux prorevêtements précédents sont isomorphes - l'isomorphisme entre les deux [-sont-] étant donc unique'.
Inserted line: 'c'est. M^~ ≃ M_{0,3}/[Π...]' should be 'c.à.d. M^ ≃ Π_{0,3}^/[Π_{0,3}^, Π_{0,3}^]' (abelianized geometric profinite π_1).
'on a par la suite exacte associée' should be 'on a la suite exacte associée à la suite spectrale de Hochschild[-Serre]'.
The margin note 'donc H^1(Γ,M^) ≃ H^0(Γ_Q, H^1(S_3,M^))' is written vertically in the left margin.
The last term of (294) on the image reads H^2(Π_Q, H^0(S_3, M)), with Π_Q (= Γ_Q) and no hat.
